method: PDF text layer: per-question [Total: N] attributed to sequential left-margin question anchors (scripts/census-igcse-printed-totals.py; clean May/June 2026 replacement PDFs preferred over watermarked copies); single-part questions use their printed part mark; a paper is accepted only when its totals sum exactly to the printed paper maximum (component standard maximum where the cover is not machine-readable) with the stored question count; every accepted total also agrees with the row transcript [Total: N] where present. Papers that do not reconcile are listed and left unchanged.
